(sum by (app) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (app) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", status_code!=""}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (app) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", status_code!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

(sum by (app) (rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", code=~"5..", reason=""}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (app) (rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (app) (rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))
